tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services and programs IRM Consulting & Advisory offers (vCISO, AI governance, GRC, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, CMMC, CPCSC, penetration testing and more), each with a one-line summary, starting price and page URL. Optionally filter by kind or by a framework name.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details of one IRM service or program: summary, audience, frameworks covered, published starting price, page URL, booking link and the related free self-assessment tool.

tools.name: list_free_products
tools.description: List IRM's free, browser-based self-assessment tools (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, CIS Controls, CMMC, CPCSC gap assessments, a cybersecurity baseline assessment and an AI Governance Playbook generator), with page and app URLs. Optionally filter by framework.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Published IRM pricing: the monthly subscription tiers (hours per month, stage, summary) and, if service_id is given, that service's starting price. All prices are USD per month and are starting prices.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Open 30-minute slots for a free consultation with IRM over the next 1 to 7 days, read live from the calendar. Each slot has a scheduling_url that opens Calendly with that time pre-selected; the person confirms the booking there.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Create a single-use Calendly link for a free 30-minute consultation with IRM. Give the link to the person; they choose a time and confirm on Calendly, which sends the confirmation. This tool books nothing itself and takes no personal data.
